title: ponytail toggle state (v1)
description: Per-project ponytail feature toggle. Single source of truth at <project>/.ai-playbook/ponytail.json. Read/written exclusively through scripts/ponytail/toggle.py. UI consumers MUST go through the CLI (python -m scripts.ponytail) rather than touching the file directly.

schema.description: Schema versioning hook. MUST be 'ponytail-toggle/v1' for this version. Future bumps require a migration script under scripts/ponytail/migrations/.

enabled.description: Master switch. When false, all components are inert regardless of their individual flags.

mode.description: Intensity level for code_style. Only consulted when components.code_style is true.

code_style.description: Inject the ponytail ladder ruleset into AGENTS.md (materialise) and enable the per-turn reinforcement hook.

review_ponytail.description: Capability flag — gates the /ponytail-review skill (over-engineering diff review). No file mutation.

audit_ponytail.description: Capability flag — gates the /ponytail-audit skill (whole-repo over-engineering audit). No file mutation.

debt_ponytail.description: Capability flag — gates the /ponytail-debt skill (harvest ponytail: comments into a ledger). No file mutation.

components.description: Per-component flags. code_style is persistent state (materialises AGENTS.md + per-turn reinforcement); review_ponytail/audit_ponytail/debt_ponytail are capability gates for on-demand skills.

applied_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of the last write. Used by audit/telemetry.

applied_by.description: Identifier of the agent/user that last toggled state. Optional. Sourced from $USER / $USERNAME by the CLI; UI consumers should set explicitly.
